class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_case(self):
        class A(): pass
        class B(A): pass
        class C2(A): pass
        class D(B, C2): pass
        self.assertEqual([k.__name__ for k in D.__mro__], ['D', 'B', 'C2', 'A', 'object'])
